summary: Tested the new background email notification (notify_team) feature end-to-end. Backend + frontend both pass. Created /app/backend/tests/test_notify.py with 7 pytest cases covering: fast (<2s) POST /api/contacto response, background Resend notification writing notificado=true + email_id to Mongo, backend log line 'Aviso de contacto enviado (<id>)', GET /api/contacto still returning list without leaking extra fields or _id, 422 validation for bad email and short mensaje without creating docs, and a unit test importing server.contact_email_html verifying HTML escaping (<script> -> <script>) and inclusion of nombre/correo/interes/mensaje. Frontend regression: /contacto form submitted with interes 'Terminales punto de venta' returned success toast and cleared fields. All 7 backend tests pass (1.96s). Test docs (QA Test / TEST prefix) cleaned up. Only 1 real Resend email was consumed during testing (test 1 creates the notified contact; the invalid-payload tests never reach Resend; the escape unit test only builds HTML).
critical_code_review_comments: logger is defined AFTER notify_team/create_contacto use it (module-level basicConfig at line 205 while functions reference `logger` at 156/168/171/180). It still works because functions run after import completes and `logger` becomes bound, but this is fragile — move logging.basicConfig + logger = getLogger(__name__) to the top of server.py near imports.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
resend.Emails.send is called via asyncio.to_thread which is good; consider adding a timeout guard to avoid a hung notify_team task from lingering in BackgroundTasks.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 QA contact via API to verify Resend notify flow; deleted at teardown (fixture) + explicit cleanup script. Verified Mongo count returns to baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified in prod-like preview: RESEND_API_KEY configured, SENDER_EMAIL=notificaciones@enlacefintech.com, NOTIFY_EMAILS=contacto@enlacefintech.com. To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notify.py -v — the module fixture cleans up QA/TEST docs automatically. Do not exceed 2-3 real sends per iteration to preserve Resend quota.
